description.html: A poster background is the simplest way to give an aquarium a neat, finished look. It hides cables, filter hoses and the wall behind the aquarium, and adds depth to the scene, so fish and plants stand out more. Fish often feel safer with a closed back, because they do not see movement behind the tank.

The roll is 50 cm high, which suits larger, taller aquariums, and the length is cut to the width of your aquarium. The photo is for illustration only: designs change, so call us to check which ones are currently available. For aquariums of a different height we also have a 30 cm roll.

The background sticks to the outside of the back glass, so it never touches the water and can be replaced at any time. Before installing, clean and dry the glass, measure the length and cut the background. It is easiest to fix with clear tape along the edges; leave a little space behind the aquarium so you can stretch it evenly. If you are still planning, take a look at our custom aquariums.

Order by phone or WhatsApp message. Fast courier delivery. Customers in Novi Sad can pick up their order directly at our workshop. Contact us with any questions about the product or for a recommendation for your species.
